notes: New in the Professor Euler Curriculum: every exercise shows its difficulty from 1 to 10, on the page, in the list and on the exercise you work on (Settings > Reading). A new guide explains how a topic is mastered and how points follow difficulty. Points now show for every course, unit and topic, with each exercise as a tile. The Curriculum opens at once, even with many workbooks. Updates are offered again: 6.3.0 was passed over because its notes were too long.
